variants.headline: Building job cancelled part-way
variants.sub: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building.
variants.body:
The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way because {why}. The client has given up the plan. Readers judging {target} should distinguish this cancellation from a completed handover and consider what responsible stewardship means when an undertaking ends with the work unfinished.

Our movement believes an undertaking remains a matter of responsibility when its purpose is abandoned. A cancelled plan should not be made invisible by the convenience of turning attention elsewhere. Political judgment needs a standard that can address unfinished work, as well as admire an intention to begin.

We fault {target} for inadequate stewardship. An undertaking abandoned part-way deserves serious scrutiny, and changing the plan should not be a convenient means of making responsibility for unfinished work disappear. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
